title: A word list
description:
Collect words in an `ArrayList` and report on them.

```
Word (blank to stop): pear
Word (blank to stop): Apple
Word (blank to stop): fig
Word (blank to stop):
3 words, sorted: [Apple, fig, pear]
Longest: Apple
Starting with a vowel: 1
```
requirements: Read words into an `ArrayList<String>` until a blank line.
Count words that start with a vowel with a method `static boolean startsWithVowel(String w)`.
stretch: Remove duplicates that differ only in case, keeping the first spelling.
